data.narrative:
Lightelligence is a public-stage semiconductor company that has raised $310M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same-stage comparables: Cerebras ($39.2B), Credo Semiconductor ($35.8B), Ouster ($2.3B), and Aeva Technologies ($1.1B). This universe spans a wide valuation range from $1.1B to $39.2B, reflecting substantial heterogeneity in the frontier semiconductor space.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach given available data. The median valuation across the four public chip companies is $19.0B. A public-comp anchoring methodology using sector price-to-sales multiples (21.4x across ALAB, NVDA, and AMD) cannot be applied because Lightelligence's revenue is not on file, consistent with typical disclosure gaps for private firms.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $16.2B to $21.9B, centered on the peer median of $19.0B. Key uncertainties include the company's actual revenue profile relative to public peers—disclosure of which would enable multiples-based cross-checks—and the degree to which Lightelligence's technological differentiation or market position justifies positioning within the upper versus lower quartile of the peer range. The single applicable method limits confidence; additional financial data would strengthen triangulation.
